en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a large, multi-story brick building with a gated entrance, typical of early 20th century institutional or military architecture. There are two men in uniform standing at the gate, and the building has gabled roofs and rows of windows. The postcard has red printed text in the top corners: 'Grimma.' on the left and 'Königin-Carola-Kaserne.' on the right.
